articles.title: Mastercard AI And Open Banking Moves Versus Emerging UK Payment Alternatives
articles.mainIdea: Mastercard AI And Open Banking Moves Versus Emerging UK Payment Alternatives
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Mastercard AI And Open Banking Moves Versus Emerging UK Payment Alternatives. Mastercard (NYSE:MA) has launched an AI agent suite for enterprises, aimed at helping clients manage payments and risk using automated tools. The company has entered its first open banking partnership with Truist, focusing on secure data sharing and integrated payment experiences. In parallel, UK banks are working on an alternative payment scheme that could reduce reliance on Mastercard and Visa networks.
